label: Athom Homey Bridge radio bridge
description: Homey Bridge adds Zigbee, Z-Wave, Bluetooth LE, 433 MHz and infrared radios to Homey Cloud or to a Homey Pro as a satellite, and needs a live internet connection to work at all. Its only network interface is 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (no 5 GHz support, no Ethernet port, powered from a USB-C supply), so it always appears on the LAN as a wireless client.
